parsed.reason: The plan names Ferber, aims it squarely at the 3am waking, and keeps every interval in line with the playbook (3/5/10, 5/10/12, 10/12/15, then nights 4-7). It carries the 1-2 minute check details, the extinction-burst warning, the working signal, the chair alternative in a clause, and the doctor triggers (snoring, gasping, no progress after 7 nights). It also gives a check-in day. Nothing is fabricated, there are no medicines or guarantees, and the register is warm. Weaknesses: the 'why' is one thin line with no evidence, and the 'expect' part is compressed: it omits 30-60+ minutes of protest on nights 1-3, which would help the parent read the hard nights. It does not say that the burst is the point where it looks like it is failing and quitting is tempting. Also missing are the caving warning (intermittent rescuing makes crying longer), agreeing on who does checks, and the morning start time. Good and usable tonight, but a bit dense and short of the full 5.
